summary: This bill amends the Small Business Act to require small business development centers to provide small firms with information, training, and outreach on evaluating and using artificial intelligence for operations including data protection, cybersecurity, regulatory compliance, and business planning.

scores.thoughts: The bill adds new responsibilities for small business development centers regarding AI assistance but includes an explicit CUTGO compliance section stating that no additional amounts are authorized. This prevents any expansion of spending and signals fiscal restraint, producing a small positive effect on the topic.
The bill contains no provisions related to taxes, tax rates, or revenue measures.
The bill contains no provisions related to healthcare policy or delivery systems.
The bill contains no provisions related to firearms or gun regulations.
The bill contains no provisions related to immigration, borders, or visas.
The bill contains no provisions related to abortion or reproductive health services.
The bill contains no provisions related to military or defense spending.
The bill contains no provisions related to environmental regulations or climate policy.
The bill contains no provisions related to welfare programs or social safety-net benefits.
The bill contains no provisions related to schools, federal education funding, or school choice.
The bill contains no provisions related to drug enforcement or decriminalization.
The bill contains no provisions related to sentencing, policing, or criminal justice reform.
The bill contains no provisions related to trade agreements, tariffs, or globalization.
The explicit CUTGO section prohibiting additional authorized funding directly supports efforts to avoid new deficit spending, producing a modest positive effect on prioritizing debt reduction.
The bill contains no provisions related to LGBTQ+ legal protections or rights.
The bill contains no provisions related to foreign aid or international assistance.
The bill contains no provisions related to voting access or election procedures.

The bill directs small business centers to provide guidance and best practices on AI use, explicitly including data protection, intellectual property safeguards, and cybersecurity. This promotes voluntary, market-oriented adoption of AI rather than new regulatory oversight, producing a moderate positive effect.
The bill contains no provisions related to unions, worker protections, or employer flexibility.
The bill contains no provisions related to religious exemptions or anti-discrimination rules.
